<includeonly>
* '''Who is playing [[Nick Swedal]] at table 4 on 4 October 2025?''' [[Robbie Hendon]], named by [[Bill Bisco]] on 25 November 2026 ([[:File:2025 World Championship table 4 October 172748.jpg|photograph]]).
* '''Who is the player in the black hoodie on the evening of 4 October 2025?''' [[Vikram Bali]], named by [[Bill Bisco]] on 25 November 2026; the File had been labelled with another player's name ([[:File:2025 World Championship black hoodie player 4 October evening.jpg|photograph]]).
* '''Who is in the 2025 World Championship group photograph?''' 38 of the 54 people are now named, matched on 25 November 2026 against named photographs of each player ([[:File:2025 World Championship group photograph.jpg|photograph]]).
* '''Who is in the 2023 World Championship group photograph?''' 32 of the 74 people are now named, 25 of them on 25 November 2026 ([[:File:2023 World Championship group photo.jpg|photograph]]).
* '''What did "FL" mean on Squadron slots?''' Flight Leader, a key volunteer who worked more directly with Decipher. Answered by [[Ming Huo]] and [[Scott Lingrell]] on the Star Wars CCG Slack, 9 October 2026 (see [[Squadron Members]]).
</includeonly><noinclude>
== Purpose ==
The latest answered cases, newest first, shown on [[Help Complete the Archive]]. The full record, with sources, is the Solved section of [[Mysteries]]. Keep five to eight entries here; when you add one, add it to [[Mysteries#Solved]] as well, with the answer and who supplied it.
